long_biography.plain_text:
Yevgeniy Petrovych Yermakov was born in Dnipropetrovsk, now Dnipro, and studied at the Donetsk Institute of Soviet Trade. He became a co-owner of AgroTechBusiness in 1993 and, with Hennadiy Butkevych and Viktor Karachun, registered ATB-Market in 1998. The partners developed six local grocery stores into a nationwide discount chain, combining standardized formats, purchased premises and distribution infrastructure.

ATB-Market remains the flagship of a wider corporation whose businesses include grocery retail, food manufacturing, transport and warehouse logistics. Yermakov remains a beneficial owner and sits on ATB Corporation's supervisory board, while separate executives run the group and its operating companies. His economic interest is therefore an ownership stake in the private group; ATB's sales, stores, factories, vehicles, warehouses and other corporate assets are not his personal property.

uncertainties.detail: The authoritative record uses Yevgeniy Yermakov. Current official sources also use Yevhen Yermakov and the Ukrainian full form Єрмаков Євгеній Петрович; English media additionally uses Yevhenii and Evgeniy. The exact birth date, partners and ATB roles resolve these variants to the same person.

Current sources establish Yermakov as an ATB beneficial owner and an ATB Holding shareholder, but public records express ownership through multiple entities and affiliates. The dossier does not convert affiliate percentages or older equal-share descriptions into a single current percentage for the entire group.

Yermakov participated in the founder-era AgroTechBusiness and ATB-Market businesses and remains an owner. ATB's current site places him on the supervisory board while separately naming operating executives, so the dossier does not describe him as the current chief executive or day-to-day manager of every subsidiary.

The available history supports a partner-built enterprise and no inheritance of the core company. Reliable public sources do not document Yermakov's family resources or starting platform sufficiently to distinguish an independent from an advantaged start, so the broader Self-made classification is used.

ATB Corporation includes food manufacturing, transport and warehouse logistics, but its own current materials identify ATB-Market as the flagship and retail as the leading activity. Fashion & Retail is therefore the best available taxonomy label despite the group's grocery rather than fashion focus.

ATB sales, cash, stores, food factories, vehicles, distribution centers, property, debt and subsidiary assets belong to the corporate entities. Yermakov's personal wealth is connected to his evidenced ownership interests, not to the gross value or revenue of every controlled business.
